comment: display.c docrt() witness: with spot_monsters on, dismissing a full-screen menu (#optionsfull) or text window (attributes) redraws the map through docrt(). Its vision_recalc(2) resets mspotted for the six now-unseen jackals and its vision_recalc(0) ends with notice_all_mons(), so the "You see a jackal." lines are printed inside docrt(). They overflow the top line, and after the menu the --More-- waits while select_menu() still has bot() disabled, so that screen keeps blank status lines.
